title: The Quarry Face
text: A cliff of fine dressed stone rises from the hillside, half quarried long ago and left. The tools are still here, rusted where they fell, as if the workers set them down mid-blow and walked away. Nobody knows why they stopped.

options.label: Everyone takes up a rusted tool and cuts where the workers left off.

outcomes.text: Good stone, and a great deal of it, and arms that ache to the shoulder.
The face gives way, the way it did for the last workers.

options.label: The sharpest eye finds the best seam, so you cut little and cut well.

outcomes.text: A little, but the finest, and a few old coins in the rubble.

options.label: Take the abandoned tools. Iron is iron, whoever dropped it.

outcomes.text: Rusted, but good. You try not to wonder why they were dropped.
